## What each table contains

Provenance and row counts.

## Licences

Two, and they are different. The environmental agency data is OGL v3.0. The storm overflow locations are CC BY 4.0, not OGL. The difference has to survive into every page that describes the data.

## Nothing here is a finding about water

The data is a vehicle for demonstrating technique. No page on this site makes a substantive claim about water quality.

## Next

To use these tables, start at [Connect your R session to the data](../jobs/connect.qmd). To cite them in a paper, see [Get results out, and get the same answer next year](../jobs/results.qmd).
